NORTHERN AREAS
GOVERNANCE
(AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2009
An Order further to
amend the Northern Areas
Governance Order, 1994
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
28th March, 2009]
S.R.O. 272(I)/2009, dated 25-3-2008.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Northern
Areas Governance Order, 1994, for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, the Government of
Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Order may be called the Northern Areas Governance (Amendment) Order, 2009
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in Article 22 of the Northern Areas Governance Order, 1994

S.R.O. 272(I)/2009, dated 25-3-2008.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Northern
Areas Governance Order, 1994, for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, the Government of
Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:--
2. Amendment in Article 22 of the Northern
Areas Governance Order, 1994.---In the said Order,
in Article 22 sub-Article (3), after the word "Pakistan" at the end,
the words "or has practiced law before the Chief Court in the Northern
Area or a High Court of any part of Pakistan as an Advocate for a period of or
for periods aggregating not less than fifteen years, or Judge of the Chief
Court Northern Areas" should be added.
